findings.title: Feature-flagged table widget renders empty data instead of the query result
findings.body: When the organization has the 'use-table-widget-visualization' feature, tableResultComponent renders TableWidgetVisualization with hardcoded columns=[] and tableData containing data: [] and empty meta. It discards result.data, result.meta, fields, aliases, custom renderers, and loading state computed immediately above. Every dashboard table widget for such an organization will therefore show an empty table with no columns instead of its actual data.

findings.title: Error events are interleaved using mismatched timestamp units
findings.body: gen_request_data compares error_events timestamps directly against recording-segment event timestamps. fetch_error_details takes the timestamp from nodestore event data, which is in seconds since epoch, while rrweb/replay segment events use milliseconds since epoch. Consequently every error timestamp is numerically far smaller than every breadcrumb timestamp, so all errors are emitted before the first breadcrumb regardless of when they actually occurred, corrupting the chronological context sent to Seer for summarization.

findings.title: Missing nodestore events misalign error IDs with event data
findings.body: fetch_error_details zips error_ids with events.values() from nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids). get_multi only returns entries for node IDs that exist (and keyed by node ID, not error ID), so if any error event is missing from nodestore, subsequent event payloads are paired with the wrong error_ids and are not dropped even though their own ID is absent. The resulting ErrorEvent objects carry incorrect ids, and the list comprehension's 'if data is not None' cannot detect the misalignment.

findings.title: Hidden span attributes are only hidden while searching
findings.body: The new HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES filter ('is_segment', 'project_id', 'received') is applied only in the branch taken when searchQuery is non-empty. When no search text is entered, sortedAndFilteredAttributes returns sortAttributes(attributes) unfiltered, so the supposedly hidden attributes remain visible in the default attributes list and are only removed after the user starts typing.

findings.title: Browser report age/timestamp mutual-exclusion validation is incomplete and falsy-sensitive
findings.body: validate_timestamp and validate_age only reject the other field when its value is truthy in initial_data, so a report with timestamp plus age=0 (or age plus timestamp=0, though timestamp also has min_value) can pass, and because both fields are required=False a report with neither age nor timestamp also passes. This accepts payloads that conform to neither the Working Draft (timestamp) nor the Editor's Draft (age) reporting format the serializer claims to enforce, allowing malformed reports to be counted as valid.
